title: Quick check: Uploading and Downloading Data

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Uploading and Downloading Data”?
options: Multipart form data should handle non-OK responses and represent loading, success, empty, and failure states.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Multipart form data should handle non-OK responses and represent loading, success, empty, and failure states.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Uploading and Downloading Data: Multipart form data should handle non-OK responses and represent loading, success, empty, and failure states.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Multipart form data?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Check response.ok before parsing success data and handle cancellation or out-of-order responses.
questions.answer_key: Check response.ok before parsing success data and handle cancellation or out-of-order responses.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Uploading and Downloading Data: Check response.ok before parsing success data and handle cancellation or out-of-order responses.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Uploading and Downloading Data” complete?
options: Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Uploading and Downloading Data: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
